description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller named AuthController that manages authentication endpoints (/register and /login) using Spring Boot annotations. It delegates authentication logic to the AuthService and handles HTTP responses accordingly.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: A REST controller providing authentication endpoints for user registration and login, utilizing Spring Boot annotations and delegating logic to AuthService.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /register for user registration; returns an HTTP response with registration outcome.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /login for user authentication; returns JWT or error message based on credentials validity.
